exposure: Vaginal cleansing with 4% chlorhexidine solution before cesarean delivery
Placebo cleansing with saline solution before cesarean delivery
cohort: 204 patients with premature rupture of membranes or labor for more than 6 hours after membranes ruptured undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: Vaginal cleansing with chlorhexidine before cesarean delivery in patients with rupture of membranes reduced the risk for endometritis and puerperal fever.
mod_finding: Vaginal cleansing with chlorhexidine before cesarean delivery in patients with rupture of membranes reduced the risk for endometritis and puerperal fever.
